events.title: Caesar narrowly escapes defeat at the Battle of Ruspina
events.description: In North Africa, Julius Caesar's outnumbered army was surrounded by Republican forces under Titus Labienus. Caesar fought his way back to camp, surviving to defeat his enemies at Thapsus three months later.
events.html: In North Africa, Julius Caesar's outnumbered army was surrounded by Republican forces under Titus Labienus. Caesar fought his way back to camp, surviving to defeat his enemies at Thapsus three months later.

events.title: Russian troops take Sofia from the Ottomans
events.description: During the Russo-Turkish War, Russian forces under General Gurko entered Sofia, ending nearly five centuries of Ottoman rule. The city became the capital of the new Bulgarian state the following year.
events.html: During the Russo-Turkish War, Russian forces under General Gurko entered Sofia, ending nearly five centuries of Ottoman rule. The city became the capital of the new Bulgarian state the following year.

events.title: Fabian Society founded in London
events.description: A group of middle-class reformers founded the Fabian Society to promote socialism through gradual reform rather than revolution. Members such as the Webbs and George Bernard Shaw later helped shape the Labour Party.
events.html: A group of middle-class reformers founded the Fabian Society to promote socialism through gradual reform rather than revolution. Members such as the Webbs and George Bernard Shaw later helped shape the Labour Party.

events.title: Soviet Russia recognises Finland's independence
events.description: Lenin's government confirmed Finnish independence, declared in December 1917. Sweden, Germany and France recognised the new state the same day, though Finland soon slid into civil war.
events.html: Lenin's government confirmed Finnish independence, declared in December 1917. Sweden, Germany and France recognised the new state the same day, though Finland soon slid into civil war.

events.title: Burma becomes independent from Britain
events.description: Burma left British rule as an independent republic outside the Commonwealth, at an hour chosen by astrologers. Independence hero Aung San had been assassinated six months earlier, and civil conflict soon followed.
events.html: Burma left British rule as an independent republic outside the Commonwealth, at an hour chosen by astrologers. Independence hero Aung San had been assassinated six months earlier, and civil conflict soon followed.

events.title: Chinese and North Korean forces capture Seoul
events.description: United Nations troops abandoned Seoul as Chinese and North Korean armies advanced, the third time the city had changed hands in the Korean War. UN forces retook it in March.
events.html: United Nations troops abandoned Seoul as Chinese and North Korean armies advanced, the third time the city had changed hands in the Korean War. UN forces retook it in March.

events.title: Sputnik 1 falls from orbit
events.description: The first artificial satellite burned up in the atmosphere after three months and some 1,400 orbits. Its launch the previous October had shocked the United States and started the space race.
events.html: The first artificial satellite burned up in the atmosphere after three months and some 1,400 orbits. Its launch the previous October had shocked the United States and started the space race.

events.title: Luna 1 becomes the first spacecraft to pass the Moon
events.description: The Soviet probe flew within about 6,000 km of the Moon's surface before heading into orbit around the Sun. Its instruments made the first direct measurements of the solar wind.
events.html: The Soviet probe flew within about 6,000 km of the Moon's surface before heading into orbit around the Sun. Its instruments made the first direct measurements of the solar wind.
